Section: Use of automated means for content moderation
Indicator: Number of measures solely taken by automated means
Contextual Information: We list here the total number of negative and definitive moderation decisions taken automatically. Dailymotion only uses automated moderation—without human review—when content matches fingerprints previously identified in INA, Audible Magic, or Dailymotion's databases. This data represents the total number of definitive negative moderation actions taken by Dailymotion, not the number of unique content whose access or visibility was effectively restricted. Since multiple moderation actions can be applied to the same content, this figure may be higher than the actual number of restricted content items. This metric tracks all negative moderation decisions regardless of the final status of the content.
